title: Build comprehensive CS1 decision intelligence v1
acceptance_criteria: Backend and Next food-decision surfaces share explicit versioned readiness, abstention, provenance, reason-code, and human-review semantics
Pre-pilot product surfaces do not expose achieved food-waste, cost, carbon, or water savings claims
All active food action/dashboard and registered decision UI surfaces respect the same claim firewall and provenance semantics
Heuristic planning bands are explicitly labeled POLICY_HEURISTIC and never described as calibrated confidence intervals
Decision readiness degrades from PILOT_READY to REVIEW_REQUIRED to WITHHOLD based on source health and required context
A baseline evaluation framework supports naive historical and operator baselines without fabricating measured results
Pilot scorecards enforce sample sufficiency, normalized waste reduction, sellout guardrails, override visibility, and data-quality checks
Machine-readable policy metadata includes policy version, model provenance, decision provenance, limitations, and reason codes
KREATE validation fails on reintroduction of unsupported food-impact claims or removal of the human gate
Technical experiment documentation distinguishes repository capability, model estimates, policy heuristics, and measured pilot evidence
Repository evidence records technical capability without promoting it to market or impact proof
Focused regression tests and repository validation lock the full CS1 decision-integrity contract
validation_commands: cd frontend && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build
notes: Scope expanded by user request from minimal core to the broad CS1 Decision Intelligence v1 workstream.
No PMR, pilot, calibration, or achieved-impact result may be invented; infrastructure may be implemented before evidence exists.
Model point estimation, policy heuristics, technical benchmarks, and measured pilot evidence are separate evidence classes.
Active dashboard/actions and registered jury/food-waste UI surfaces are included to prevent provenance drift.
Does not touch .github/workflows/ci.yml because TASK-FABRIC-CLI currently owns that path.
